dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.platform.getBundles.to.javaplugin.getBundles>
<!description: Replace org.eclipse.core.runtime.Platform.getBundles with org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaPlugin.getDefault().getBundles. This migration improves bundle resolution, particularly for unresolved bundles, as per the commit message (Bug 414444). This rule assumes the target environment's JavaPlugin class has been updated with the new getBundles method.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: eclipse, api-migration, bundle-resolution>

org.eclipse.core.runtime.Platform.getBundles($bundleName, $version)
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaPlugin.getDefault().getBundles($bundleName, $version)
;;
summary: Replaced `Platform.getBundles($bundleName, $version)` with `JavaPlugin.getDefault().getBundles($bundleName, $version)` to use an internal, more robust bundle resolution mechanism in Eclipse JDT UI.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
